description: This file implements the SetVolume class, which is responsible for setting the volume of a media stream within a GStreamer pipeline. It includes constructor, destructor, and execute methods, and interacts with external GStreamer wrapper functions.

classes.name: SetVolume
classes.description: A class responsible for setting the volume of a media stream in a GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetVolume object with context, GStreamer wrapper, and volume level.

methods.name: ~SetVolume
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of SetVolume operations.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the volume setting operation on the GStreamer pipeline, with null pipeline check and error logging.
